# Eizport

> Eizport gives Tools → Export a new screen and .wxrz bundles: content with its media, settings and post content files in one file. Choose items and what they use comes along as suggestions; import with the WordPress Importer, or send the file as a plugin that imports itself. Free and open source.

WordPress plugin, version 1.1.1, for WordPress 7.0+ and PHP 7.4+, GPL. Source: https://github.com/eizport/eizport. Install: https://wordpress.org/plugins/eizport/ (or `wp plugin install eizport`). Every page below is Markdown; the whole documentation is in one file at https://eizport.github.io/llms-full.txt.

The plugin itself is agent-ready: every export, import and setting is an ability of the WordPress Abilities API (REST, PHP, MCP) — see Developers → Abilities.

## What's new in 1.1.1

- Fixed: Tools → Import → WordPress no longer shows the importer unstyled for a moment before its header and cards appear.

## Site

- [Overview](https://eizport.github.io/index.md): what the plugin does, features (suggestions, export as a plugin too), formats, the plugins it works with (WooCommerce; ACF and Elementor not tested yet), developers, FAQ.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://eizport.github.io/docs/getting-started/introduction.md): What Eizport does, how it fits into WordPress's own export and import, and where to go next.
- [Installation](https://eizport.github.io/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install the plugin from the WordPress.org plugin directory, check the requirements, and add the WordPress Importer for imports.
- [Your first export](https://eizport.github.io/docs/getting-started/your-first-export.md): Export a page with its media and the homepage setting, in under a minute.
- [Importing](https://eizport.github.io/docs/getting-started/importing.md): How a bundle is imported with the WordPress Importer, what happens to media, content files and options, and the other ways to import.
- [Multisite](https://eizport.github.io/docs/getting-started/multisite.md): Eizport on a WordPress network: network or per-site activation, who can do what, where each site's files go, WP-CLI with --url, and uninstalling.

## Use cases

- [Header menus to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/header-menus-to-staging.md): A site built locally — pages, a header menu with submenus and its theme location — repeated on staging without rebuilding the menu by hand.
- [Theme look to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/theme-look-to-staging.md): A change to a theme's look made locally — the last CSS rule, the logo, one widget, or a block theme's palette — taken to staging without touching what staging has of its own.
- [Site header to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/site-header-to-staging.md): A block theme's header redone in the Site Editor locally — a new layout, its navigation, an image — and a page template, taken to staging in place of the ones staging has, without a Header 2.
- [Galleries to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/galleries-to-staging.md): Pages built with Image, Gallery and Cover blocks, moved to a site where the media get other IDs — and still editable as they were.
- [Internal links to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/internal-links-to-staging.md): Pages that link to each other, to products and to categories, built locally and moved to staging — with every link pointing to staging, not back to the local site.
- [Product categories to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/product-categories-to-staging.md): A store's products moved with their categories as they are — descriptions, parent categories and thumbnails — not just their names.
- [Second delivery to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/second-delivery-to-staging.md): Delivering new pages to a staging site that already has the media from the first delivery — without duplicating the images and without links to the local site.
- [Subsite to subsite](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/subsite-to-subsite.md): On a network, a site built in one subsite moved to another — the live one, or a fresh copy — with its media, links and settings pointing to the right site.
- [Client demo in Playground](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/client-demo-in-playground.md): A new page shown to a client in WordPress Playground: one link that opens right on that page, with the site's plugins as they are.
- [Playground in your language](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/playground-in-your-language.md): A demo of an English site shown in Portuguese in WordPress Playground: the dashboard, the theme and the plugins translated, from one link.
- [Custom post types in Playground](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/custom-post-types-in-playground.md): A site whose post types live in a must-use plugin, shown in WordPress Playground: the plugin goes in the .zip and runs before the import.
- [Advanced Custom Fields to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/advanced-custom-fields-to-staging.md): Recipes built with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) — their post type, taxonomy, field group and values — taken to staging with every photo, page and term they point to pointing right.
- [Elementor to staging](https://eizport.github.io/docs/use-cases/elementor-to-staging.md): A landing page built with Elementor — its images, a saved section template and the site's global colors and fonts — taken to staging with Elementor's own importer, everything pointing to staging's items.

## Exporting

- [Export screen](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/export-screen.md): The new Tools → Export screen, part by part: the header actions, the Details panel, the list and the side panels.
- [Choosing items](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/choosing-items.md): Items per content type, chosen in the side panel at once; suggestions; the Selection filter; children, attachments, reviews and roles.
- [Options](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/options.md): Export site settings one by one, by group or all at once; linked settings; what is never exported; how IDs are mapped.
- [Menus](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/menus.md): Classic menus with their items and theme locations, and block navigations, on their own row; what's suggested, what the import does with menus the other site already has, and the limits.
- [Appearance](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/appearance.md): The site's look on rows of its own, item by item: Customizer theme mods and CSS rules, the Site Editor's style groups, CSS rules, templates and template parts, and widgets — with a preview of each, the media they use, and how the other site takes them.
- [Advanced Custom Fields](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/advanced-custom-fields.md): Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) on a row of its own: its post types, taxonomies and field groups in ACF's own export format, imported before the content, and the fields that store IDs pointing to the items on the other site.
- [Elementor](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/elementor.md): Elementor with its own exporter and importer: the site settings (the Kit) and templates on a row of their own, each page's design as a .json file, and on import every image, template and link pointing to the items on the other site.
- [Media](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/media.md): Which attachments come with the items exported, how media files go inside bundles, and the "Only attached media" setting.
- [File and formats](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/file-and-formats.md): Choose between WordPress's plain WXR, a .wxrz or .zip bundle, a Playground .zip and a plugin that imports itself; file names and what each one holds.
- [As plugin](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/as-plugin.md): Export a plugin that imports its own bundle: install it on the other site, check what it needs, Run import, then delete it.
- [Saved defaults](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/saved-defaults.md): Save the Export screen's choices as default, per user or for the whole site, on both screens.
- [Classic screen](https://eizport.github.io/docs/exporting/classic-screen.md): WordPress's own Tools → Export with the plugin's choices added, for those who prefer it; also on phones.

## Formats

- [WXRZ bundle](https://eizport.github.io/docs/formats/wxrz-bundle.md): The .wxrz format, entry by entry — manifest, WXR, media, post_content and options.json — and the safety rules when one is opened.
- [ZIP bundle](https://eizport.github.io/docs/formats/zip-bundle.md): The same bundle as a plain .zip, which any computer opens — how to turn it on and how it is read.
- [Playground zip](https://eizport.github.io/docs/formats/playground-zip.md): A WordPress Playground blueprint bundle that boots a site with the exported content, media, theme and plugins — how it's built and how to run it.

## Settings

- [General](https://eizport.github.io/docs/settings/general.md): The plugin's Settings → General — whether Tools → Export is replaced, the classic screen, saved defaults and how long copies are kept.
- [Export settings](https://eizport.github.io/docs/settings/export-settings.md): The plugin's Settings → Export — attached media, linked settings, .zip bundles and content as .html files.
- [Copies](https://eizport.github.io/docs/settings/copies.md): The exports kept on the site — download, open in Playground, copy the link, import, delete — and how their links work.

## Developers

- [AI agents](https://eizport.github.io/docs/developers/ai-agents.md): Let an AI agent export, import and manage copies for you: the abilities over MCP, what to ask, what the agent sees, and the safety built in.
- [Abilities](https://eizport.github.io/docs/developers/abilities.md): Every eizport/* ability of the WordPress Abilities API — input, output, permission — over REST, PHP and MCP.
- [Hooks](https://eizport.github.io/docs/developers/hooks.md): Every filter and action of Eizport, with its parameters and an example.
- [Compatibilities](https://eizport.github.io/docs/developers/compatibilities.md): Which plugins are supported (WooCommerce, Advanced Custom Fields, Elementor), how support is built from the public hooks, and how a plugin ships its own.
- [WP-CLI](https://eizport.github.io/docs/developers/wp-cli.md): Export and import bundles from the command line with wp eizport export and wp eizport import, keep a delivery in a folder to compare, and run the abilities with wp eval.
